headline.id: Membangun sistem web skalavel & pengalaman digital elegan.
headline.en: Crafting high-performance web systems & elegant digital products.

subheadline.id: Hai, saya Satya. Menggabungkan arsitektur backend berkecepatan tinggi dengan keahlian antarmuka React & Next.js yang bersih, modular, dan responsif.
subheadline.en: Hi, I'm Satya. Bridging robust low-latency backend architectures with modern React & Next.js user interfaces that are fluid, accessible, and clean.

bioP1.id: Saya adalah seorang Full-Stack Developer dengan lebih dari 4 tahun pengalaman membangun sistem digital untuk perusahaan teknologi dan rintisan inovatif. Menguasai siklus hidup software secara menyeluruh: mulai dari desain skema basis data relasional hingga pengalaman pengguna akhir yang responsif.
bioP1.en: I am a Full-Stack Developer with over 4 years of experience architecting digital products for high-growth tech companies and enterprise clients. I thrive across the full software lifecycle: from relational database schemas to responsive, high-fidelity user experiences.

bioP2.id: Bagi saya, perangkat lunak yang hebat tidak hanya sekadar berjalan, tetapi mudah dipelihara, diuji secara komprehensif, dan memberikan nilai nyata bagi pengguna dengan latensi seminimal mungkin.
bioP2.en: For me, great software is not just functional—it is maintainable, thoroughly tested, and delivers delightful tangible value to users with minimal latency.

education.id: S.Kom - Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak / Ilmu Komputer
education.en: B.Sc. in Software Engineering / Computer Science

desc.id: Membangun antarmuka dinamis dan responsif dengan Next.js 14, React Server Components, TypeScript, serta CSS modern yang mengutamakan aksesibilitas dan kemulusan 60fps.
desc.en: Crafting fluid, high-fidelity responsive user experiences with Next.js 14, React Server Components, TypeScript, and modern CSS tuned for WCAG accessibility.

desc.id: Merancang REST API, GraphQL, microservices efisien, autentikasi terproteksi dengan Node.js, Express, serta Golang untuk pemrosesan paralel berlatensi rendah.
desc.en: Engineering resilient REST and GraphQL microservices, hardened auth workflows, and concurrent event pipelines via Node.js, Express, and Golang.

desc.id: Otomasi containerization dengan Docker, multi-environment CI/CD pipeline, edge compute Vercel, dan manajemen cache Redis untuk menjamin reliabilitas produksi.
desc.en: Containerizing services via Docker, automated zero-downtime CI/CD workflows, edge runtime caching, and Redis layers ensuring 99.9% uptime reliability.

desc.id: Penerapan clean code, pengujian otomatis (unit, integrasi, E2E), modularitas terisolasi, dan audit Core Web Vitals dengan skor Lighthouse 95+ secara konsisten.
desc.en: Disciplined clean code principles, automated test coverage (unit, integration, E2E), strict decoupling, and sub-100ms response targets with 95+ Lighthouse audits.

summary.id: Platform SaaS analitik multi-tenant dengan dasbor metrik real-time, manajemen tim, pelacakan langganan MRR, dan visualisasi data interaktif.
summary.en: Multi-tenant enterprise analytics SaaS platform featuring real-time telemetry dashboards, team collaboration, MRR tracking, and interactive charts.

overview.id: Nexa SaaS dirancang untuk menyederhanakan pemantauan metrik bisnis SaaS dan aktivitas pengguna. Menggunakan arsitektur modular yang memisahkan ingestion pipeline berkecepatan tinggi dengan antarmuka analitik yang responsif.
overview.en: Nexa SaaS was engineered to streamline SaaS business metrics monitoring and user activity auditing. Utilizes a modular architecture decoupling high-speed ingestion pipelines from responsive UI dashboards.

architecture.id: Frontend dibangun menggunakan Next.js 14 App Router dengan React Server Components untuk rendering secepat kilat. Backend didukung oleh Node.js microservices, PostgreSQL untuk integritas relasional, dan Redis cache cluster untuk optimasi query analitik.
architecture.en: The frontend is powered by Next.js 14 App Router with React Server Components for lightning-fast rendering. The backend is orchestrated via Node.js microservices, PostgreSQL with connection pooling, and a Redis cluster for analytics caching.

id: Autentikasi multi-tenant aman berbasis JWT dengan role-based access control (RBAC)
Sinkronisasi data real-time menggunakan Server-Sent Events (SSE) dan WebSocket
Dukungan multi-mata uang dan integrasi webhook pembayaran langganan Stripe
Kompresi data time-series menghemat penyimpanan database hingga 35%
en: Secure multi-tenant authentication with RBAC and session protection
Real-time live telemetry stream via Server-Sent Events and WebSockets
Multi-currency recurring billing with Stripe webhook synchronization
Time-series log compression saving up to 35% database footprint

challengesSolved.id: Tantangan utama adalah menangani lonjakan query agregasi ketika ribuan pengguna melihat dasbor secara bersamaan. Solusinya diatasi dengan partisi tabel PostgreSQL dan materialized views yang disegarkan secara bertahap via worker queue Redis.
challengesSolved.en: The core challenge was scaling aggregate analytics queries under sudden peak loads. Solved using PostgreSQL table partitioning and materialized views incrementally refreshed via a background Redis worker queue.

summary.id: Platform e-commerce responsif dengan katalog instan, filter multi-atribut dinamis, keranjang belanja terenkripsi, dan alur checkout minimalis 3 langkah.
summary.en: High-performance headless e-commerce platform with instant client-side catalog search, multi-faceted filtering, encrypted carts, and streamlined 3-step checkout.

overview.id: Urban Market mengutamakan kecepatan navigasi dan kenyamanan bertransaksi di perangkat desktop maupun seluler. Menyediakan pengalaman belanja tanpa hambatan berkat optimasi gambar otomatis dan pre-fetching rute.
overview.en: Urban Market prioritizes navigation speed and friction-free transactions across devices. Delivers seamless shopping through automatic asset optimization and aggressive route prefetching.

architecture.id: Mengusung pola headless commerce dengan decoupling penuh antara storefront dan backend order engine. State keranjang dikelola secara optimistik dengan sinkronisasi local storage dan sinkronisasi server asinkron.
architecture.en: Adopts a headless commerce architecture fully separating frontend storefront from the order fulfillment backend. Cart states are managed optimistically with persistent storage and asynchronous server sync.

id: Pencarian produk instan di bawah 50ms dengan debounced fuzzy search
Integrasi pembayaran internasional dan metode transfer lokal
Automasi notifikasi email resi dan update status pengiriman via webhook
Dukungan mode gelap dan mode terang dengan adaptasi visual penuh
en: Sub-50ms instant product lookup with debounced fuzzy search indexing
International payment processing and localized payment rails
Automated receipt dispatch and tracking status alerts via webhooks
Adaptive light/dark visual theme support across all checkout steps

challengesSolved.id: Mencegah race condition ketika beberapa pembeli melakukan checkout terhadap stok barang terakhir secara bersamaan. Diatasi dengan database row-level locking dan atomic stock deduction pada level transaksi ACID.
challengesSolved.en: Preventing race conditions when multiple concurrent shoppers purchased limited stock items. Solved using database row-level locking and atomic stock deductions within ACID transaction boundaries.

summary.id: Aplikasi visual node-graph builder untuk merangkai pipeline LLM agenik, pengujian prompt interaktif, dan inspeksi kode generasi secara real-time.
summary.en: Visual node-graph workspace for chaining agentic LLM workflows, interactive prompt prototyping, and live real-time code generation inspection.

overview.id: NeuroFlow adalah developer tool modern yang memungkinkan rekayasawan perangkat lunak menyusun alur kerja AI kompleks (RAG, tool invocation, evaluator) tanpa menulis skrip berulang.
overview.en: NeuroFlow is a modern developer platform that empowers software engineers to design multi-step agentic AI pipelines (RAG, tool calling, evaluators) visually with live testing.

architecture.id: Canvas antarmuka dibangun dengan React dan kustomisasi TypeScript canvas SVG. Engine eksekusi berbasis Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) di backend Python FastAPI memvalidasi siklus node dan mengeksekusi sub-tugas secara asinkron.
architecture.en: The interface canvas is engineered in React with custom TypeScript SVG connectors. A high-throughput Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) engine in FastAPI validates node graphs and triggers tasks concurrently.

id: Ekspor otomatis konfigurasi alur kerja ke kode Python (Flask/FastAPI) dan TypeScript
Integrasi multi-penyedia model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, serta model lokal Ollama)
Inspeksi real-time untuk waktu inferensi, penggunaan token, dan error log
Fitur collaborative workspace dengan shareable read-only snapshot URL
en: One-click workflow export to production-ready Python or TypeScript boilerplate
Multi-model provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and local Ollama models)
Real-time telemetry inspector for token cost, latency breakdown, and log tracing
Collaborative workspace sharing with encrypted read-only snapshot links

challengesSolved.id: Menjaga performa canvas tetap stabil pada 60fps saat ratusan node dan konektor kabel bergerak. Dioptimalkan dengan virtualisasi rendering canvas dan debouncing status graph.
challengesSolved.en: Maintaining smooth 60fps canvas panning and zooming with hundreds of connected nodes. Solved with viewport virtualization and selective graph node re-renders.

desc.id: Server Components (RSC), SSR, ISR, kustom Hooks, dan arsitektur state responsif (Zustand/Redux).
desc.en: React Server Components, SSR, ISR, custom hook composition, and scalable state stores.

desc.id: Sistem token desain, layout fluid responsif, glassmorphism, dan animasi performa tinggi 60fps.
desc.en: Design token systems, fluid responsive layouts, glassmorphism, and 60fps hardware-accelerated animations.

desc.id: RESTful architecture, modular middleware, JWT session security, dan komunikasi real-time WebSocket.
desc.en: RESTful architectures, modular middleware, secure JWT sessions, and WebSocket event pipelines.

desc.id: Skema relasional ternormalisasi, query indexing cepat, transaksi ACID, dan migrasi terotomasi.
desc.en: Normalized relational schemas, index tuning, atomic ACID transactions, and automated schema migrations.

desc.id: Multi-stage containerization, docker-compose, edge deployment, dan automated CI/CD pipeline.
desc.en: Multi-stage container builds, docker-compose orchestration, edge functions, and automated CI/CD.

desc.id: Branching strategies, code review workflows, automated test runners, dan semantic versioning.
desc.en: Git workflow strategies, comprehensive PR reviews, automated test pipelines, and semantic versioning.

desc.id: Penerjemahan pixel-perfect, aksesibilitas WCAG, dan optimalisasi audit Google Lighthouse 95+.
desc.en: Pixel-perfect fidelity from design specs, WCAG accessibility compliance, and 95+ Lighthouse audits.

description.id: Memimpin tim rekayasa web dalam merancang arsitektur analitik SaaS multi-tenant berbasis Next.js 14 dan microservices Golang. Berhasil memangkas waktu muat halaman hingga 40% dan mengorkestrasi CI/CD zero-downtime deployment.
description.en: Spearheaded web architecture for multi-tenant analytics SaaS using Next.js 14 and Golang services. Reduced initial page-load latency by 40% and orchestrated zero-downtime CI/CD deployment pipelines.

description.id: Membangun lebih dari 12 aplikasi web berskala enterprise untuk klien teknologi dan e-commerce. Mengintegrasikan payment gateway Stripe & Midtrans serta merancang caching Redis berkecepatan tinggi.
description.en: Engineered 12+ enterprise web platforms across fintech, retail, and tech startups. Integrated Stripe & regional payment systems and implemented resilient Redis caching tiers.

description.id: Mengembangkan antarmuka landing page interaktif pixel-perfect, optimalisasi performa animasi web, serta mencapai skor 95+ secara konsisten pada audit Google Core Web Vitals.
description.en: Crafted interactive pixel-perfect landing platforms, optimized client-side animation rendering, and consistently attained 95+ scores across Google Core Web Vitals audits.

description.id: Fokus studi pada Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak, Struktur Data & Algoritma, Basis Data Terdistribusi, dan Jaringan Komputer. Lulus dengan predikat Sangat Memuaskan (IPK 3.82/4.00).
description.en: Majored in Software Engineering, Data Structures & Algorithms, Distributed Systems, and Computer Networks. Graduated with Honors (GPA 3.82 / 4.00).
